description: Convert a date (and optional time): Gregorian, Chinese lunar and stem-branch pillars, the solar term it falls in with exact term times, and true solar time when longitude is given. Price: $0.01 per date.

date.description: YYYY-MM-DD; with calendar=lunar this is the lunar year-month-day

leap.description: calendar=lunar: the month is a leap month

time.description: HH:mm local clock time (for the hour pillar and true solar time)

tz.description: IANA zone of the clock time

name: calendar_convert
